notes.title: Lion Quest Infinity 1.2.2
notes.content:
Here comes Lion Quest Infinity version 1.2.2. This update adds and changes the following:


Small dialogue adjustments and numerous spelling/ grammar corrections
Corrected a couple of situations where the label for the speaking character was wrong
Fixed some issues with the player's jump not curbing correctly
E key can now also be used for interactions
Fix for lamp triggers not working properly in the player's house
Engine upgrade
Splash screen has been removed
Miscellaneous shader upgrades
Minor geometry fixes
Minor physics revisions
Fixed an issue where clear blue trail objects would revert to their original colour if they made contact with the game camera

notes.title: New year, new patch
notes.content:
Lion Quest Infinity version 1.2.1 is here. This is just a small patch with the following changes:


Revisions to Missile Kid collisions
Minor collider adjustments to the Rooftop Pool map
Fixed some issues where the input maps would not load correctly
Engine upgrade
Spelling and grammar
Pause menu text adjustment for LQVi
Minor icon fix in LQVi
Fix for issues swapping resolution

notes.title: Lion Quest Infinity version 1.2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39023933/b1f0305db645b8569b98e2d5346e7645f704e10d.jpg

A new update for Lion Quest Infinity arrives today! It includes the following cool changes:


Sloth Tales and LQi Versus: D-pad input support for character movement
New intro section for Sloth Tales
Support for M1 Macs
Improved handling of uncapped framerates
Tutorial icons for high-jump
Xbox/ PlayStation/ Keyboard specific controller glyphs
Fix for replay characters not saving correctly
Improved support for non-standard screen widths
Engine upgrade
Minor geometry adjustments
Minor physics and lighting adjustments
All sorts of minor bug fixes

notes.title: A wild patch appears
notes.content:
Version 1.1.2 is now live on Steam to address the following:


Patch for level end sequence
Special code box
Some code refactoring and miscellaneous optimisations

notes.title: Lion Quest Infinity 1.1.1
notes.content:
A new patch appears! This addresses the following:


Removed reset from LQVi
Improved missile physics for Here Comes Missile Kid
Splash screen flicker fix (Mac OS)
Pool ramp has been moved slightly nearer

notes.title: A small patch...
notes.content:
To fix some things
–The dash jet effect was missing (and probably has been missing for many months). It's back.
–Fix for Heist level not ending sometimes
–Spelling corrections
–New effect on RB Paradox level
–Someone found a shortcut in Zen II. The shortcut is no more.
